Priya (CS): FYI OraHealth asked for EU region enablement + temp rate bump while they ramp onboarding. renewal ping is in 45d, want to avoid churn risk.
Marco (Solutions): Got it. Do they need dedicated capacity or just region routing to eu-west?
Priya (CS): They said 'low latency for EU customers' — prefer hosted in eu if possible. Also need an IP allowlist for their corp proxy and a 2x TPS increase for 72h during demo week.
Sandeep (AM): Renewal flagged — they mentioned competitor latency numbers in last call. Can we get a fast timeline? If we can commit to a short SLA improvement that helps renewal.
Liam (Sales): I'll loop legal for SLA wording if infra can guarantee region-based routing and the temp bump. Sales wants a note to include in renewal playbook.
Marco (Solutions): @eng-runtime any objections to spinning up an eu edge route and applying a temporary rate override? We'll also set up prefix caching config.
eng-runtime: We can route to eu-west and create a rate policy. Need the customer's IPs for allowlist and the exact endpoints they use. Pref timeline: 24-36h to validate.
Priya (CS): Sending IPs now (they gave two ranges).
Priya (CS): ```
# OraHealth allowlist
13.82.100.0/24
13.82.101.0/24
```
Marco (Solutions): Thanks. We'll add those to the allowlist for their org id orahealth-prod. Also will create a temp policy: rate_limit_per_minute = current*2 for route /v1/generate, window 72h.
redwood-bot: Applied allowlist entries to org orahealth-prod (change-id: ch_2026_0047). Pending rate policy creation.
eng-runtime: Creating rate override now. Will test with a quick load to ensure KV cache warms correctly.
Marco (Solutions): If dev notices tails of latency >150ms after route, fallback to a nearby variant (smaller model) until cache warms. We'll add that as an automated fallback for the 72h window.
Sandeep (AM): This is great — can we capture customer feedback at end of the demo? If they still call out latency, we'll log it in the renewal notes.
Priya (CS): I'll schedule a 30-min enablement session for Tuesday with OraHealth engineers and Solutions to walk through observability and TTLs. Also will send the post-demo survey link.
Liam (Sales): I'll update the renewal tracker: "Temp EU route + 72h 2x rate bump applied, enablement scheduled, capture feedback post-demo."
redwood-bot: Rate override created (policy-id: rp_2026_118). Active for 72h from 2026-09-10T14:20:00Z.
Marco (Solutions): Quick checklist for handover: 1) confirm metrics dashboard shared with customer; 2) enable trace hooks for devs; 3) note fallback model mapping.
Priya (CS): I'll attach the dashboard link in the customer portal and share during enablement.
Sandeep (AM): Thanks team — keeping an eye on renewal signal. If demo goes well, we should propose a Dedicated pilot in EMEA as next step.
Priya (CS): Closing loop here. Will post results after demo and add feedback to renewal doc. :thumbsup:
